16.why: defective: three options do not react with NaOH
16.notice: As printed, three options fit. Copper oxide, potassium oxide and calcium oxide are all basic oxides that do not react with sodium hydroxide; only aluminium oxide (amphoteric) does. Copper oxide (A), the one that also does not react with water, is the answer kept here.

90.why: option C as printed is also not a right
90.notice: Option C is printed as 'To act as a witness against himself/herself', which is also not a right (Article 20(3) protects a person from being COMPELLED to be a witness against himself). B, refusing a handwriting sample (Kathi Kalu Oghad), is the intended answer.

94.why: D is true law but not from this case
94.notice: Two options can be read as 'not correct' for Maneka Gandhi. B contradicts what the case held, and D (no right to die) is settled law but comes from Gian Kaur (1996), not Maneka Gandhi. B is the intended answer.
